title: "draft-faq-response skill"

Step 5 (FAQ branch) of the human IT ticketing workflow: turn a matched FAQ entry into a customer-safe email response.

## Layout

```text
skills/draft-faq-response/
├── SKILL.md
├── README.qmd
├── install.sh
└── scripts/
    └── draft_faq_response.py
```

## Install

```bash
bash skills/draft-faq-response/install.sh
```

## Usage through Claude

> "Draft the FAQ-based response for TKT-00042."

Claude reads `SKILL.md`, verifies the upstream FAQ decision is a match, runs the script, and reports the draft text plus any quality-check warnings.

## Direct CLI

```bash
uv run python skills/draft-faq-response/scripts/draft_faq_response.py --ticket-id TKT-00042
```

The script appends one row to `data/working/customer_response_drafts.csv` with `message_source=faq`, plus an action-log row.

## Public functions

- `load_response_context(data_dir, out_dir, ticket_id)` — loads ticket, FAQ entry, and the latest faq_decision; raises `LookupError` if the upstream branch isn't FAQ.
- `draft_faq_response(context)` — pure dict → dict. Builds `draft_text`, `sent_text`, `customer_action_required`, `follow_up_request`, `included_context`.
- `quality_check_response(draft)` — flags missing fields and internal-only phrasing.
- `build_response_row(context)` — full row for `customer_response_drafts.csv`.
- `write_customer_response(out_dir, response)` — appends.
- `main(argv)` — CLI. Exits 2 on missing ticket / data, 3 on missing or wrong-branch upstream FAQ decision.

## Refusal behavior

The script refuses to draft when:

- there is no `faq_decisions.csv` row for the ticket,
- the latest decision has `faq_match_found != true`,
- the latest decision recommends a step other than `draft-faq-response` (typically because the customer hasn't supplied required info — escalate instead),
- or the matched `faq_id` does not exist in `faq_knowledge_base.csv`.

In every case the script exits non-zero and prints a one-line message to stderr naming the upstream skill the user should run instead.

## Test

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_draft_faq_response.py -v
```
